blockingFindings.title: R2 invalidation comparison relies on an impossible object shape
blockingFindings.target: specs/337-repair-stale-evidence-ledger/tests/stale-evidence-repair-transaction.test.js: test "R2: refresh appends one continuous ledger entry after retry"
blockingFindings.rationale: A test that is not executable or clearly contradicts the target API blocks implementation because it will fail for the wrong reason before exercising production behavior.
blockingFindings.issue: The test calls `entry.invalidations.map((record) => record.toJSON())` after `readImplRepairLedger(...)`. Ledger JSON records are very likely plain parsed objects, not class instances with `toJSON()`. That makes the test contradict the persistence API shape instead of checking the requirement.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Compare the persisted invalidation records directly, or convert them through the actual ledger reader API if it intentionally returns value objects.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: A test that is not executable or clearly contradicts the target API blocks implementation because it will fail for the wrong reason before exercising production behavior.
